scripts/prepare-compiled-publication.py

Python · Tier B

Prepare a validated local download-repository overlay for compiled artifacts.

Usage

--source BUILD --existing-checkout DOWNLOADS --destination EMPTY_DIRECTORY; --component server selects available controller variants, while the default selects inference-portal.

Inputs

Build manifests, exact artifact hashes and a materialized download checkout.

Side effects

Copy selected artifacts and write merged manifests, checksums and installation instructions in the destination. Never commit, push or deploy.

Cleanup

The temporary release-note directory is removed on exit; the reviewable destination remains owned by the caller.

@see build/README.md

@see scripts/generate-smto-release-manifest.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
prepare 32 Validate selected artifacts and retained siblings, then write an additive overlay. Variant identity keeps enabled/external controller records distinct. Reject a nonempty destination, mixed targets, missing components or changed retained binaries instead of publishing an incomplete merged manifest.
